topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I opened the mailbox, expecting the usual ads and bills, but out slipped a glossy brochure instead. It depicted my apartment building, the one I've called home for years, suddenly transformed into a grand, modern condo complex. The brochure talked about luxurious upgrades and spacious new layouts, inviting me to 'discover the new chapter in my living story.' The coffee I was about to sip seemed to pause mid-air, floating between the cup and my mouth. The world around me felt like it was about to rearrange itself, the walls whispering of change, the floors subtly shifting underfoot. The familiar chirping of the birds outside seemed to echo a new tune, one of unfamiliar beginnings.
